claim: The benefits of multi-agent co-evolution (distributed exploration and shared persistent memory) transfer across different model backends, including open-source models.
falsifier: Replicate the comparison using a different open-source model stack on the same task suites to test whether the advantage persists.

conditions: evaluated on math and systems suites
exclusions: limited to the reported tasks and the specific open-source models tested; transfer to other open-source or proprietary models is unestablished

title: Multi-agent co-evolution with shared–final scores relative principle
